standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: Minutes not read: medleydocs.com (Laserfiche WebLink) returned a cookie error page to the fetcher and the browser pane was refused, even after site access was granted. Every action except the July 7, 2025 Florida Wood item is listed from the agenda with roll null; outcomes, movers and votes are unknown.

No agenda posted for January 2025, February 2025, August 2025 (cancelled per July 7 agenda) or January 2026 (cancelled per Dec 1 agenda); the Sept 22, 2026 second budget hearing agenda is not on the page

Items that recur on later agendas (Florida Wood, pet crematorium, Titan Florida, Verra Mobility, Vetted Security, Res-Des Palmetto, UniCapital) were probably deferred at the earlier meeting; each listing is kept until minutes confirm the outcome
Agendas omit many vendor and claimant names (insurance renewals, vehicle purchases, settlement claimants, land sale buyer)
Member roster not confirmed; roll keys limited to Ayala and Rodriguez (the two incumbents tracked on the site)
